def quiet_fill(self, liters):
    self.amount += liters
    print(self.name, "+", liters)

Tank.fill = quiet_fill
t = SafeTank("K", 5)
t.fill(3)
try:
    t.fill(3)
except ValueError as e:
    print("오류:", e)
print(t.room())

def new_init(self, name):
    self.name = "[" + name + "]"
    self.amount = 1

Tank.__init__ = new_init
t = SafeTank("K", 5)
t.fill(4)
print(t.room(), t.capacity)
